title: Server Rules & Quality of Life
h1: Minecraft Server Rules, Anti-Cheat and Quality-of-Life Tweaks Explained
description: Survival server rules on PvP, griefing, cheat mods and land claims, plus quality-of-life tweaks, ban appeals and how to reach staff on a Minecraft server.
intro: Good survival servers are defined by their rules as much as their features: what fights are fair, what counts as griefing and which tweaks make everyday play easier. These answers cover both. MatchaSMP is the worked example.

items.q: Is PvP allowed on a Minecraft survival server?
items.a: On MatchaSMP, PvP is allowed if it's fair. Tp-trapping and spawn-killing are not. Teleports have a 3-second warmup that moving or taking damage cancels, so you can't teleport out of a fight.

items.q: Are cheat mods allowed on a Minecraft server?
items.a: No. An anti-cheat runs on MatchaSMP, and mods like X-ray, freecam or Wurst are banned. Suspected players may be asked to run a verification mod.

items.q: What is the punishment for griefing on a Minecraft server?
items.a: On MatchaSMP, griefing and stealing are not allowed. The first offence gets a warning, and the second gets a temporary ban.

items.q: Can you claim land on a Minecraft survival server?
items.a: There is no land claiming on MatchaSMP. Respect other players' builds.

items.q: How do I lock a chest or hide an item frame in Minecraft?
items.a: On MatchaSMP, chests can be locked so only you and the players you allow can open them. Crouch and right-click an item frame with shears to lock or unlock it, or with a brush to make it invisible.

items.q: How do I keep a chunk loaded in Minecraft?
items.a: Drop a Nether Star on a lodestone. On MatchaSMP the chunk stays loaded until the lodestone is broken.

items.q: How do I merge an elytra with a chestplate in Minecraft?
items.a: Drop both on an anvil. Enchantments are kept. Drop the result on a grindstone to split them again.

groups.title: Is it pay-to-win, and how do I appeal?

items.a: No. MatchaSMP is non pay-to-win: the store only sells quality-of-life items and cosmetics.

items.q: How do I appeal a ban on a Minecraft server?
items.a: On MatchaSMP, open a ticket on Discord, the fastest route, or email the staff address listed on the wiki's support section.
